newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday July 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday July 21.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Democratic Party of the Left (PDS) leader Massimo D'Alema said centre-right opposition head Silvio Berlusconi attacked judges' independence and favoured political impunity for the powerful. Berlusconi called PDS leader a follower of Stalin's technique of blaming political opponents for something they did not mean (all).
* In an interview, foreign trade minister Augusto Fantozzi warned Italian entrepreneurs to be watchful and alert in a global and highly competitive market (La Repubblica).

* Telecom Italia shares are to be quoted on Monday on the Milan bourse after the formal document to agree the merger of state-controlled telecoms operator Telecom Italia into telecoms holding company STET was formally signed on Tuesday, and the formal merger took place on Friday (all).
* Treasury minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi confirmed that the 1998 Italian budget would come be for 25 trillion lire of deficit-cutting measures (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
